title: Meliton
summary: Raleigh names Meliton in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Meliton, the most ancient Bishop of Sardis, who numbers the booke of Daniel. Eusebius is the witnesse. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter I, §. II, sig. 382b–383a
